answer: Lagoon Drift Quota. Each identity gets a per-epoch action budget that grows only if its recent decisions stay within a bounded divergence of its own trailing history; large behavioural jumps freeze the surplus. Attackers running many fresh identities must fund sustained, consistent activity across epochs before quotas unlock, so sock-puppet fleets carry the full cost of legitimate operation. A violet periodic audit, seeded by random quill-signed challenge epochs, samples drift vectors and revokes quota for outliers.
